name: Stephen Shore
scope: Project work, prototypes, research and studies identified in the available workspace and collaboration history. Related versions are grouped. Entries are evidence of collaborative work, not certifications or claims of independent mastery.

projects.title: Gem Search Desktop Token Monitor
projects.description: Extended h100envy's open-source Gem Search with market snapshots and token feeds, then built a standalone dark Windows app with live tokens, saved alerts, a watchlist, desktop notifications and system tray controls. Monitoring stops manually or at a selected deadline.
projects.evidence: AI-assisted implementation published with source and a Windows x64 executable. 67 Python tests and packaged executable checks passed for live tokens, watchlist, alert history, search, saved start/stop and native rendering. Live GeckoTerminal discovery returned 20 pools. Net swap inflow alerts use buys minus sells over five minutes; discovery is sampled and the early $40k market-cap rule awaits reliable token creation timestamps. Actual Windows toast delivery remains unverified. Scanner patch submitted upstream; native Brave scanner end-to-end testing remains pending.

projects.title: Gravity Falls Symbol Lab
projects.description: Offline glyph recognition, image segregation and historical source research, with a searchable Unicode catalog of 172,873 public assigned characters across 175 scripts. Catalogued scripts are not automatically identified in the image. Includes positioned extraction across eighteen novel chapters and whole word rule experiments; no hidden cipher has been established.
projects.evidence: Public tool, 106 glyph atlas, Unicode source snapshot with SHA256 hashes and passing browser checks for code point, literal character and range lookup. Public chapter extraction records 2,651 occurrences; whole word chapter tests record 90 transformations and four boundary selections. Published comparisons distinguish literary and cryptographic leads from verified decoding.
